prompts.initial:

sheet_generation.civilian:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: complete civilian animation sprite sheet for a GTA 2-like top-down game.
Create ONE clean transparent PNG sprite sheet in a precisely aligned 4-column by 6-row grid, ideally 1024 x 1536 pixels with 256 x 256 square cells. No visible grid lines or labels.
STYLE: match a classic hand-painted top-down Survivor game character sprite: medium detail, a few clear shaded cloth folds, simple hair mass with restrained highlights, crisp silhouette and antialiased edges. NOT photorealistic, not a detailed 3D product render, no individual hairs or fabric microtexture, no pixel art, no flat cartoon, no thick cartoon outline.
SAME ordinary adult male civilian throughout: short dark brown hair, muted navy casual jacket, grey shirt, dark jeans and shoes, warm medium skin. No weapons, armour or equipment.
VIEW: strict vertical overhead view like GTA 2, facing NORTH toward the TOP of every cell. We see the crown of the head, shoulder tops and top of the back, with arms and feet foreshortened. NOT a front-view person looking down. Hair/head orientation agrees with body: forehead, hair fringe, nose direction and shoe toes point toward TOP; rear of skull toward BOTTOM. His face is mostly hidden by overhead projection.
GRID ORDER, left to right:
Row 1: WALK cycle phases 0,1,2,3.
Row 2: WALK cycle phases 4,5,6,7, completing one natural loop. Opposite arm and leg swing, quiet upright walk.
Row 3: RUN cycle phases 0,1,2,3.
Row 4: RUN cycle phases 4,5,6,7, completing one natural loop; bent elbows and clearly longer stride.
Row 5: relaxed IDLE arms down; left-arm PUNCH toward north; right-arm PUNCH toward north; LYING face down on ground, whole body visible, head toward north.
Row 6: standing raised right fist SHOUT gesture; second raised-fist SHOUT gesture with slightly different fist position; completely empty transparent cell; completely empty transparent cell.
Every occupied cell contains exactly ONE pose. Maintain identical appearance, body scale, orthographic camera and lighting across all 22 frames. Body/hip pivot fixed at the centre of each cell. Body does not translate during the cycles. Keep enough transparent margin to contain extended hands, feet and lying pose. Transparent background with actual alpha; no cast ground shadows, text, checkerboard, props or scene. Soft simple upper-left shading only. A usable game animation sheet, not a character illustration.
